title: ElectroNeek + Pax8 = Automation made easy for MSPs and their clients
summary: Austin, TX (July 18, 2024): ElectroNeek, RPA workflow automation platform, today announced that its core products in RPA, Document Processing and Process Manage
body_markdown:
Austin, TX (July 18, 2024): ElectroNeek, RPA workflow automation platform, today announced that its core products in RPA, Document Processing and Process Management categories[joined Pax8 marketplace](https://www.pax8.com/en-us/vendors/electroneek/) , empowering Pax8 partners to automate processes and documents internally and for their clients.


ElectroNeek’s platform enables managed service providers (MSPs) to streamline internal processes, automate workflows and repetitive tasks, and offer automation services to clients with ease. By integrating ElectroNeek’s user-friendly and cost-effective robotic process automation (RPA) tools with the Pax8 Marketplace, MSPs can deliver enhanced value and drive digital transformation for their clients.


Pax8 partners can now drive digital transformation for their clients, automating processes like extraction of information from ACORD form and entering it on a website. Also, with AI capabilities to process support tickets, ElectroNeek users among MSPs can achieve significant internal efficiencies and grow business without reliance on the headcount increase.


Sergey Yuodvskiy, CEO of ElectroNeek: "Partnering with Pax8 is a pivotal step for ElectroNeek, allowing us to deliver our state-of-the-art GenAI and RPA solutions to a wide network of MSPs. This collaboration enhances our ability to drive innovation and operational efficiency. We are excited about the opportunities this partnership brings to revolutionize the automation landscape for our partners and their customers."


Ryan Burton, Vice President of Marketplace Vendor Strategy at Pax8: “We are excited to partner with ElectroNeek, a visionary in automation technology. This collaboration expands the range of solutions available on our marketplace, empowering partners to automate their own business processes and deliver unparalleled automation capabilities to their clients.”


**About ElectroNeek**


[ElectroNeek](https://electroneek.com/) transforms enterprise business process management by integrating RPA bots and AI agents with employee workflows, automating routine processes, and helping humans focus on more creative and strategic tasks. Since its start in 2019, it has enabled hundreds of MSPs and enterprises to automate millions of work hours and reached clients in 50+ countries globally.


**About Pax8**[Pax8](https://www.pax8.com/en-us/) is the Managed Service Provider technology marketplace of the future, linking partners, vendors, and small to midsize businesses (SMBs). With a global partner ecosystem of over 35,000 managed service providers, Pax8 empowers SMBs worldwide by providing software and services that unlock their growth potential and enhance their security. Committed to innovating cloud commerce at scale, Pax8 drives customer acquisition and solution consumption across its entire ecosystem.
